requirement.description: The validation logic in BaseAWSObject.__setattr__ completely bypasses type checking for all AWSHelperFn objects, preventing proper validation of the Tags property in resource classes like JobDefinition and Table.
requirement.contract: The validation logic should allow AWSHelperFn objects like GetAtt to pass through for dict-type fields (as they represent valid AWS expressions that resolve to dicts at runtime), but should still enforce type checking for incompatible types like Tags objects passed to dict fields.
